title: Gators Parasail
specs: Flight includes views of Tampa Bay beaches and Gulf of Mexico
Optional dipping during ride if conditions allow
Participants under 18 must have a parent or guardian sign liability waiver
Minimum combined weight 130-165 lbs, maximum combined weight not fully stated
includes: Coast Guard licensed captains and fully-trained crew
gap: Maximum combined weight not fully stated
blurb: Guests parasail over the Gulf of Mexico from Madeira Beach, enjoying views of Tampa Bay beaches. Flights begin seated on the back deck of the parasailing boat and lift guests gently into the air. The experience includes a freefall to simulate parachuting and optional dipping if conditions allow.
extraNote: Business licensed with City of Madeira Beach and fully insured · John’s Pass Village & Boardwalk in Madeira Beach, near Don’s Dock

quotes.author: Stephen Aultman
quotes.text: The staff went above and beyond to accommodate a handicap young lady who wanted to parasail for her birthday. This group went out of their way to make sure this young lady got to parasail on her birthday. Me and my wife had a great time at Gator parasailing. We rented jet skis from the same group. Had a wonderful time and once again, Thank you for being so kind and taking your time to make sure her birthday was a birthday she will never forget!!

quotes.author: Aaron Zaffiro
quotes.text: It was super fun. They took really good pictures of us. It was definitely worth paying for the pictures. I wanted pictures anyways, and I was gonna ask someone to get them of me, but then they offered it with like a really nice camera for an extra fee and I accepted it and I’m glad I did. They turned out really good. It’s also really safe. They put a lot of time and effort in the making sure it’s really safe.

quotes.author: D
quotes.text: Capt Bryce and Alayna were amazing, professional and friendly. Would highly recommend this parasailing trip to anyone visiting the area!
Amazing time as always! We parasail here every year and it's always a blast! Awesome and helpful staff.

quotes.author: Shannon Taylor
quotes.text: Had such a great time. Gators Parasailing was top notch.

Gators Parasail was so amazing! Captain Bryce and Trevor were friendly and made the whole process so seamless and enjoyable. It was our first time parasailing and they made us feel safe and secure during the whole adventure! Highly recommend!
